_doc: Uso igual nos dois jogos: a altura da via lida de elevationAt e o mesmo desgaste escrito no campo do 4.0, um valor em cada braço do cruzamento (0,25, 0,5, 0,75 e 1), nas poses do par.

const S=window.__roadcraft.scene();const P=S.gl.properties;let U=null;S.scene.traverse((o)=>{if(U||!o.material)return;for(const m of [].concat(o.material)){const q=P.get(m);if(q&&q.uniforms&&q.uniforms.uWear){U=q.uniforms;break;}}});window.__U=U;const j=window.__j;const cell=U?U.uWearWindow.value.z/2048:0;const unit=cell/5;const h=(dx,dz)=>S.elevationAt(j.x+dx*unit,j.y-dz*unit)/unit;JSON.stringify({achou:!!U,cell,unit,j:[j.x,j.y],no:h(0,0),longe:[h(0,25),h(0,-25),h(25,0),h(-25,0),h(0,60),h(60,0)],janela:U?[U.uWearWindow.value.x,U.uWearWindow.value.y,U.uWearWindow.value.z]:null,bytes:U&&U.uWear.value.image?U.uWear.value.image.data.length:0})

const U=window.__U;const j=window.__j;const R=2048;const cell=U.uWearWindow.value.z/R;const unit=cell/5;const t=U.uWear.value;const d=t.image.data;const rects=[[12,32,-9,9,.25],[-32,-12,-9,9,.5],[-12,12,12,32,.75],[-12,12,-32,-12,1]];let n=0;const md=(a)=>((a%R)+R)%R;for(const [x0,x1,z0,z1,v] of rects){const px0=j.x+x0*unit,px1=j.x+x1*unit,py0=j.y-z1*unit,py1=j.y-z0*unit;for(let gy=Math.floor(py0/cell);gy<=Math.floor(py1/cell);gy++)for(let gx=Math.floor(px0/cell);gx<=Math.floor(px1/cell);gx++){const k=(md(gy)*R+md(gx))*2;d[k]=Math.round(v*255);d[k+1]=Math.round(v*255);n++;}}t.needsUpdate=true;window.__roadcraft.redraw();String(n)
